newsitem.title: JAPAN: IBJ shares slip to low for this year.
newsitem.headline: IBJ shares slip to low for this year.

text.p: Shares in Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd (IBJ) slipped to the lowest level for this year on Thursday.
The share price was down 40 yen at 1,980 yen at 0132 GMT, below the previous low for the year of 2,000 yen marked on December 13. Volume was 393,000 shares.
The IBJ shares were dragged down by the news that non-bank lender Koei Corp was seeking liquidation under court protection by the end of March.
IBJ is a major creditor of Koei Corp.
"It is true that we will go in that direction (to seek liquidation). We will probably apply to the Tokyo District Court for special liquidation by the end of March," a Koei official said on Thursday.
An IBJ spokesman said Koei had informed the bank of its liquidation plan and that the bank would agree to the plan.
